title: Elden Ring
extract: Elden Ring is a 2022 action role-playing game developed by FromSoftware and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. It was directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki and Yui Tanimura, with worldbuilding by the fantasy writer George R. R. Martin. It was released for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S on February 25, 2022, and for Nintendo Switch 2 on August 28, 2026. Players control a customizable character on a quest across the Lands Between to repair the Elden Ring and become the new Elden Lord.
